title: Paloma and the Salt
author: Tamsin Fairweather
blurb: Ulyana Thackeray, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
